    • sortApp

      protected static ISort sortApp(String name, ISort... params)
      Creates the sort expression name(params...), e.g. sortApp("Array", intSort, intSort) for (Array Int Int). Used to build canonical sorts for structural comparison (via ISort.equalsNoExpand(org.smtlib.ISort)), rather than comparing printed text.

    • checkArraySort

      protected void checkArraySort(ISort sort, IExpr.IIdentifier id, String allowedMsg, ISort... allowedSorts) throws IVisitor.VisitorException
      Checks that the sort expression contains no Array sort outside the allowed set. Skips the check for Array sorts whose parameters include sort parameters (parameterized abbreviations).
      Parameters:
      allowedMsg - human-readable list of allowed Array sorts, used in the error message
      allowedSorts - the allowed Array sorts, compared structurally (see sortApp(java.lang.String, org.smtlib.ISort...))
      Throws:
      IVisitor.VisitorException
